headline: New test: CompactSelectedSeries decrements numStaleSeries only for stale evictions
summary: Adds a test that appends one stale series and two non-stale series, then checks that evicting a non-stale series through CompactSelectedSeries leaves Head.numStaleSeries unchanged, and that evicting the stale series brings it to zero. It is a new test-only file change with no production effect, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
reason: New test in a _test.go file; adds coverage without removing or weakening existing assertions.
